TRIAL MOTION CALENDAR ON MAY-04-2010 IN DEPT. 220, PLAINTIFF ARMAND SCHMITT'S MOTION FOR PREFERENCE / PREFERENTIAL SETTING HELD. NO OPPOSITION FILED. THE COURT ADOPTED IT'S TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR TRIAL PREFERENCE IS GRANTED. TRIAL IS SET FOR 11:15 AM ON AUGUST 16, 2010, IN DEPARTMENT 206. 120TH DAY IS SEPTEMBER 1, 2010. PARTIES TO STIPULATE THAT THE LAST DAY FOR HEARING SUMMARY MOTIONS IS AUGUST 5, 2010, ALL PAPERS SERVED BY E-SERVICE DO NOT ADD ANY ADDITIONAL DAYS, SUMMARY MOTIONS CAN BE HEARD ON 15 DAYS NOTICE WITH OPPOSITION DUE 7 DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING AND REPLY DUE 3 DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING. PLAINTIFF TO MAKE A DEMAND WITH AN EXPLANATION ON ALL DEFENDANTS NO LATER THAN 1PM ON AUGUST 5. DEFENDANTS TO RESPOND WITH AN EXPLANATION NO LATER THAN 5PM ON AUGUST 9. MSC IN ROOM 603 AT 9AM ON AUGUST 10. PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER ABOUT ALL OTHER DISCOVERY AND SCHEDULING ISSUES. PLAINTIFF SHALL DISCLOSE THE NAMES AND ADDRESSES OF ALL IDENTIFICATION AND LAY WITNESSES, AND PRODUCE ANY DOCUMENTS THAT SUPPORT THEIR TESTIMONY, AS TO EACH INDIVIDUAL DEFENDANT BY 30 DAYS AFTER THE GRANTING OF PREFERENCE. ALL DEFENDANTS SHALL DISCLOSE THE NAMES AND ADDRESSES OF ALL LAY WITNESSES THAT THE INDIVIDUAL DEFENDANT LEARNED OF THROUGH ITS OWN DISCOVERY EFFORTS AND THAT WILL RELY ON PROPOSITION 51 PURPOSES OR FOR THEIR AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES, AND PRODUCE ANY DOCUMENTS UPON WHICH THESE WITNESSES SUPPORT, AS TO EACH DEFENDANT BY 50 DAYS AFTER THE GRANTING OF PREFERENCE. PLAINTIFF TO PREPARE AN ORDER. JUDGE: JUDGE HAROLD E. KAHN; CLERK: E. BURA; MATTER NOT REPORTED. (220)
